tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ nges don gyi lta sgom nyams su len tshul ji lta bar ston pa rdo rje'i mdo 'dzin zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 494)swa sti pra dzā bh+yaḥ bsam gyis mi khyab sna tshogs chos kun gyi// rang bzhin gdod nas rnam dag byang chub sems// ma bcos gnyug ma lhan skyes chos kyi sku// lhun grub rang rig bla mar rtogs pas 'dud/ ༈ 'gro ba'i khams la bde gshegs snying po yis// khyab kyang lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pas// rtag par rang sgribs 'khor mtshor byings 'di las// myur grol gsang ba'i zab lam 'dir bstan gyi/ ༈ sdug chen ngan 'gro'i g.yang la skrag pa dang*/ 495)/lam gol nyan rang zhi bder ma chags dang*// tshe gcig rdzogs byang 'grub la spro ba yi// blo dman skal ba mchog rnams 'dir 'jug byos/ ༈ e ma ho smon lam ldan pa'i smon lam mtshan// gang gi phyag rdzogs dbu gsum lta sgom gyi// snying po'i nyams len 'gag don smros shig ces// gsungs ba'i lan gyi brda mtshon 'di 'bul lo/ ༈ gang zhig dus gsum rgyal kun gyis// chos 'khor bskor ba'i rnam grangs ni// mtha' dag sems can sangs rgyas 496)sar// 'god phyir kho na yin mod kyang*// gdul bya'i bsam skal tha dad pas// 'dul byed chos kyang sna tshogs pa// ma lus rgyal ba'i phrin las nyid// yin phyir bzang ngan yod min kyang*// lam gyi rten dang lam nyid dang*// 'bras bur dngos su sbyor mdzad pa// theg pa chung 'bring chen po ru// grags mod sangs rgyas bsgrub par mthun/ ༈ 'on kyang nye lam yin min gyi// khyad kyis theg chen mchog tu 'phags// de las khyad par sngags kyi lam// gong ma kho na rmad du 'gyur// de yang gzhi dang lam nyid dang*// 'bras bu dang ni gsum gsungs kyang*// 'khor 'das dbyer med sku gsum klong*// gzhi 'bras ro gcig las ma 'das/ ༈ 'on kyang gzhi la 'khrul bral gyis// de nyid ma shes blo bur ba'i// ma rig mun pa bsal slad du// lam gyi nyams

497)len du mar bstan/ ༈ de dag snying po lta sgom gnyis// thog mar lta ba'i don nyid la// ngo 'phrod kho na mchog tu gces// lta ba la yang sna tshogs te// 'jig rten pas ni ma rtogs dang*// mu stegs pas ni log par rtog /de dag byang chub lam min phyir// zhib dbye 'dir ni brjod ma byas// de tshul shes par 'dod pa na// gsar rnying mdo rgyud du ma dang*// bstan bcos chen po rnams su ltos// theg dman nyan rang lta ba yang*// nyan thos pas ni gang zag gi /bdag med rtogs kyang chos kyi bdag /ma rtogs yul snang a 'thas 'dzin// rang rgyal bas ni de yi stong*// 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med nyid// rtogs kyang gzung ba chos bdag med// ma rtogs pas na rnam par rmongs// nyan rang gnyis 498)ka'i sgom pa ni// 'gog pa'i bsam gtan snyoms 'jug bsgom// spyod pa phar phyin lnga spyod kyang*// shes rab phar phyin lhag mthong gis// ma zin phyir na gol bar gsungs// theg chen byang sems sde snod la// sems tsam pa dang dbu ma pa// sems tsam rnam bden rnam rdzun gnyis// lta ba 'khor 'das sems su 'dod// dbu ma rang rgyud pa rnams ni// lta ba bden gnyis zung 'jug bzhed// dbu ma thal 'gyur ba rnams ni// lta ba khas len bral bar gsungs// kun kyang sgom pa gsal stong zung*// dbyer med rang rig rang gsal du// so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis// gtan la 'bebs shing sgom par byed// spyod pa phar phyin bcu dag gis// rang gzhan don gnyis 'bad nas bsgrub// 'bras bu grangs med gsum nas ni// byang chub 499)bla med thob par bshad// gsang sngags phyi pa kṛ yog rnams// lta ba dag pa mtha' bzhi bral// sgom pa bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel bsgom// spyod pa gtsang sbras lha mchod cing*// so so'i dam tshig bsrungs pa yis// mi tshe bdun nam bcu drug tu// sangs rgyas sku lnga thob par gsungs// gsang sngags nang pa bla med pas// lta ba snang stong snod bcud lha// sgom pa bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi// chags grol dbang bzhi'i lam bzang zhugs// spyod pa phrin las rnam dag sogs// thun mong thun min sbyaur sgrol gyi// thabs kyi rim pa bsam yas pas// mchog thun rang bzhin don 'grub pa'i// 'bras bu tshe gcig kho nas bsgrubs/

༈ de ltar theg pa'i rim pa rnams// so so'i 500)lha sgom dbye rim ni// dpag med mdo rgyud bstan bcos las// 'byung phyir bdag 'dras brjod pas ci// bdag ni spyir yang thos pas dben// khyad par dbu tshad phar phyin sogs// gzhung lugs thos bsam ma byas pas// de dag lta ba'i dbye bsdu sogs// mi shes smras kyang mkhas pas 'khrel// de bas chos dbyings bsam mi khyab// nyid la mos pas gnas par bya/ ༈ skabs 'dir bshad bya'i don gyi snying po ni// sngags dang mtshan nyid theg pa'i lta ba la// khyad par med kyang thabs kyi rim pa'i gnad// nyams len nyid kyi khyad par yin no zhes// gsar rnying mkhas grub phal cher gcig tu gsungs// 'ga' zhig gis ni shin tu khyad yod par// gsung ba'ang yod la 'gag don snying po ni/ 501)/lta ba'i rang bzhin nyid ni mthun na yang*// blo yis bcos dang ma bcos khyad par ram// zhe 'dod der 'jin yod med khyad par ni// 'dug par rmongs pa bdag lta bus kyang mthong*// rang bzhin mtshan ma gang du'ang ma grub kyang*// gang zag blo yis stong dang stong min dang*// mtha' bcas mtha' bral la sogs sna tshogs su// brtag gzhig byas par gtan la 'bebs 'dod kun// phyag rdzogs rnams kyi lta bar ma gsungs shing*// mtha' dang bral lo stong nyid yin no ces// snyam byed de ni lta ba'i gol sar zad// brjod bral 'dus ma byas pa'i chos nyid la// rang rig ye shes rang ngo 'phrod pa yis// yin tshul yin lugs rjen par rtogs pa las// blos byas yid dpyod lta bas dgos pa 502)med/ ༈ ji skad du/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa las/ rab 'byor/ de lta bas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni bya ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa nye bar gnas pa ste/ sems kyi bsam par mi nus so/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di las sems dang sems las byung ba'i chos mi 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ zhes sogs gsungs shing*/

gzhan yang*/ til+lo pa'i zhal nas/ kye ho/ 'di ni rang rig ye shes te// ngag gi lam 'das yid kyi spyod yul min/ zhes sogs dang*/ mai tri pas/ chos rnams rang rang ngo bos stong*// stong par 'dzin blo rang sar dag /blo bral yid la mi byed pa// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun gyi lam/ zhes dang*/ 'gro mgon zhang rin po ches/ lta ba dngos po'i gnas lugs rtogs 'dod na// lta ba ma blta lta ba'i bya ba thongs// lta dang mi lta zhe 'dod bya bral na// bya ba btang ba lta ba'i mthar thug yin/ ces gsungs pa dang*/ mkha' spyod klu 'phreng las/ mtha' bcas dang mtha' bral la sogs pa'i// bzang 'dod kyi lta ba rdzun gyi khrigs// yin lugs kyi lta ba tha mal pa// blta rgyu 503) yang mi gda' bltas kyang rung*/ ces dang*/ gzhung tha snyad mkhan gyi bden gnyis de/ lung rig pa mang yang gnad ma go /gnyis tha dad du bzung pas gnyis med nyams// blo spang blang gi 'khrul 'khor rgyun mi chad/ ces sogs lung brjod las 'das pa mchis so/ rgyal gsung 'khor lo mtha' dang bar pa yis// dgongs don byams dang 'jam dbyangs kyis bkral ba'i// rjes 'brang thogs med klu grub la sogs pa'i// shing rta'i srol chen dbu sems gzhung lugs la// skyon du mchis pa nam yang ga la srid// de dag rnams dang phyag rdzogs lta ba la// dgongs don mi mthun ci yang med mod kyang*// phyis byung gang zag mkhas rlom mang po yis// rang bzo'i dri mas dbu sems bslad pa mang*// gtan tshig dgag bsgrub tha snyad sna tshogs kyis// bsgrubs pa'i 504)go yul lta ba ci bzang kyang*// rang byung ye shes ji bzhin rtogs min tshe// byang chub lta zhog nyon mongs cung zad tsam// kha yang ma phri slar la nga rgyal dang*// shes rlom thos pa che ba'i yus kyi rgyal// chos la brten nas ngan song bsgrubs pas phung*/ ji skad du/ bram ze chen po sa ra has/ gang zhig bla ma'i gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i chu// gdung sel bsil ldan ngom par mi 'thung ba// de ni bstan bcos don mang mya ngam gyi// thang la skom pas gdungs te 'chi khar zad/

ces gsungs so// ༈ des na tha snyad tshig gi lta grub la// mi 'brang ma zhen zab mo'i don rgyud kyi// lta sgom nyams len rang thog dbab pa gces/ ༈ 'o na sgom gyi sngon 'gro'i sems tshol rnams// blaus byas brtag gzhig min nam zhes snyam na// min te de dag bla ma'i byin rlabs dang*// rang sems 505)mnyam gzhag ngang nas byung gnas 'gro// thams cad sgom byung shes rab kyis rtogs las// kun tu g.yo ba'i blo yis btsal ba min// 'gal ba bsdus pa'i bsam mno mang po yis// kun tu brtags pa'i go yul skam po dang*// rang sems rang ngo mthong 'di mtshungs ma yin/ ༈ 'o na lam zab mo 'di dag gi lugs kyis rang ngo mthong ba'i lta ba dngos de gang lta bu zhig yin ce na/ ༈ bden gnyis zung 'jug mtha' bral dbu ma dang*// gnas lugs ma bcos ye shes phyag rgya che// gdod ma'i kun bzang ka dag rdzogs chen rnams// ma lus dgongs pa gcig tu mthun pa'i don// 'gro ba kun la khyab pa'i sems nyid 'di// ngo bo cir yang ma grub ye nas stong*// rang bzhin 'char sgo 'gags med rig cing gsal/ 506)/zung 'jug yod med yin min rtag chad kyi// mtshan ma kun bral blo yis dpog min zhing*// gdod nas lhun grub sus kyang byas pa med// rang byung rang shar rang rig chos nyid don// 'di la ming gi rnam grangs sna tshogs te// phar phyin theg par chos nyid bden pa zer// sngags kyi theg pa rang bzhin 'od gsal zer// sems can dus na bde gshegs snying po'i khams// lam gyi skabs su lta sgom la sogs ming*// 'bras bu'i dus na sangs rgyas chos sku zer// de sogs ming dang dbye ba du ma yang*// don la da lta'i tha mal shes pa 'di'o/ ༈ /'khrul pas ma bslad gong na ka dag zer// 'khrul bcas dri mar ldan dus kun gzhir brjod/ 'khrul pa'i gnas tshang rig tshe lta bar bzhed// ngo shes yengs med 507)skyong la sgom par grags// spyod lam kun tu ma 'khrul spyod pa'i ming*// bag chags 'khrul pa sangs tshe 'bras bu'o// de ltar rang sems 'di nyid gcig pu la// gzhi lam 'bras sogs gnas skabs tha dad kyi// ming dang dbye bsdu zad mtha' med par 'byung*// rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu kun// thams cad 'di don rtogs phyir kho na'i ched// yin kyang ming tshig mang po de dag gis// gang zag mgo bo 'khor zhing rmongs par gda'// gsal rig stong gsum dbyer med sems nyid 'di'i// rang bzhin mthong bya mthong byed gnyis med par// mthong la lta ba'i gnas lugs rtogs par brjod// 'di ni don rgyud byin rlabs mos gus kyi// rkyen dang tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang ma lags pa// dran pa gsal dang thos pa che ba'am/

508)/spyang grung 'dzom pas 'di don rtogs nus min/ skal ldan las 'phro can gcig dgos par gda'o/ ji skad du/ grub thob lū hi pas/ 'khor 'das chos rnams dngos po ma yin dngos med min// gnyis ka yin pa'ang min la min pa'ang min par ltos// byis pas mtshon par dka' ste bla ma mnyes las 'byung*// de las rnyed na ma mthong pa yi don mthong 'gyur/ ces dang*/ te lo pa yi rdo rje'i glur/ lhan cig skyes pa gnyug ma'i ye shes 'di// 'gro ba kun gyi snying la gnas gyur kyang*// bla mas mi mtshon rdzogs par mi 'gyur ro/ zhes dang*/ mnyam med sgam po pas/ phal dang phal gyi spyod yul min// thos pa che bas shes pa min// dad pa can gyi go ba yin// byin rlabs lam la gnas pa yin// bla ma'i gsung la brten pa yin/ ces dang*/ rgyal ba 'bri gung pas/ gsang sngags byin rlabs lam pa yin// bla ma'i byin rlabs ma zhugs na// ji ltar rtogs kyang 509) blo byas yin// blo ni kun rjob sgrib par bshad// des na bla ma mnyes byas la// skyo dub med par gsol ba gdab/ ces sogs gsungs pas/ lta ba gnas lugs kyi don phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i thabs ni mos gus dang byin rlabs la rag las so// ༈ de ltar lta ba'i ngo mthong nas// nyams su ji ltar len zhe na// theg pa 'og ma pa rnams su// lta ba stong pa nyid kyi don// sor rtog shes rab kyis dpyad pas// gtan la phabs nas nyams len ni// stong nyid snying rje zung sgom zhing*// tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong 'bad par gsungs/ ༈ gsang sngags phyi nang spyi khyab tu// lta ba'i rgya yis theb pa'i ngang*// bskyed rim lha yi rnal 'byor dang*// rdzogs rim mtshan bcas mtshan med rnams// zung 'brel tshul du bsgom par bshad/ ༈ de ltar 510)rnam grangs tha dad kun// rgyal ba thabs la mkhas pa yis// spros can gdul bya 'dul phyir du// gsungs mod ngo mtshar che lags kyang*// theg pa'i rtse mo phyag rdzogs kyi// nyams len skabs 'dir de dag kun// lta dang sgom pa so so ru// byas phyir 'di dang cung mi mtshungs/

༈ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i lta ba de// bzo med rang babs sor 'jog pa'i// lta sgom dbyer med ma gtogs pa// tha dad pa ru 'dir mi bzhed/ ༈ gang zag dbang po'i khyad par gyi// rab la zhi lhag dbyer med du// thog ma nyid nas ngo sprod cing*/ mnyam bzhag rjes thob gzhag len kyang*// mi dgos chos nyid gdal khyab klong*// rtogs dang grol ba dus mnyam 'gyur/ ༈ dbang po 'bring tha'i rigs spyi la// sngon 'gro'i rigs rnams rtags 'thon rjes/ 511)/lta ba'i brdar sha legs par bcad// sems kyi ngo bo mthong nus tsam// byung tshe gnas cha skyong bya ste// lus ngag yid gsum zo glod nas// rnam rtog 'gyu ba snga phyi yi// rjes 'brang mi bya de ltar gyi// sems la sems kyi cer gyi blta// gzugs sgra dri sogs tshogs drug kun// bkag pa ma yin rjes 'brang min// gang snang gang shar thams cad la// hrig ge sa le rjen ne bar// grim lhod ran pas bskyang bar bya// ha cang bsgrim na bcos mar 'gyur// lhod drag 'og 'gyu rgya 'byams 'khrul// de ltar ma yin ma yengs tsam// 'di la mchog gi zhi gnas zhes// sgom gyi gzhi rten nyid du gsungs/ ༈ ding sang zhi gnas bsgom mkhan 'ga'// tshogs drug 'gags pa'i mi rtog la// bzang 512)por 'dod pa snang mod kyi// de ni 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ces// sgom gyi skyon dang gol sar gsungs// 'bras bu gzugs med khams su'am// klu dang dud 'gror skye rgyur bshad// grol ba'i lam du gtan mi 'gyur/ rje sa skya pas/ blun pos phyag rgya che bsgom pa// phal cher dud 'gro'i rgyu ru gsungs// min na gzugs med khams su skye// yang na nyan thos 'gog par lhung*/ ces gsungs pa de yang 'di lta bu la gsungs pa yin mod kyi/ lar yang 'gyu ba bkag nas mi rtog pa zhig ched du nan gyis bsgom pa des ni byang chub mi thob par mdo rgyud thams cad nas nan gyi gsungs te/

ji skad du/ rgya cher rol pa las/ shākya thub pa de bzhin gshegs// mngon par byang chub 'di bzhed nas// stong pa yi ni sangs rgyas nyid// thob par bya zhes mngon dgongs te// nai rañja na'i chu 'gram du// mi g.yo'i ting 'dzin la bzhugs pa// de tshe rgyal ba mkha' rdo rje// til gyi gang bu khengs bzhin byon// rgyal

513) ba'i sras la se gol dang*// de la dbyangs gcig gis gsungs pa// bsam gtan 'di ni rnam dag min// 'dis ni mthar thug mi thob ste// nam mkha'i ngos ltar mchog gyur pa'i// 'od gsal ba de dmigs kyis shig ces dang*/ de ltar sgra de gsan pa dang*// de nas ting 'dzin mi g.yo btang*/ ces sogs rgyas par gsungs la/ gzhan yang sngon nyang ban ting nge 'dzin bzang po des rgya'i hwa shang zhig la bsam gtan bsgom thabs zhus te rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ zag bcas kyi mngon shes sogs nyams snang mang po shar ba la sgom bzang por rlom yod pa'i tshe/ paṇa chen bi ma la dang mjal bas/ nyang ban gyi bdag la ting nge 'dzin bzang po 'di lta bus nyin zhag mang por 'byams shing zas skom mi dran pa yod zhus pas/ de 'dras klu ru skye/ dgos pa med gsungs nas ma mnyes/ slar paṇa chen de nyid la btugs te rdzogs chen zhus nas bsgom pas 'od lus 'grub pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ ༈ rje sgam po pas bka' gdams kyi gdams ngag la brten nas bsgoms 514) pas ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams bzang po yod tshul rje mi la'i drung du zhus pas/ bzhad mo mdzad nas bye ma tsir ba las mar khu mi 'ong*/ de bas nga'i gdams ngag 'di bsgom dang*/ ces sogs gsungs tshul shin tu mang phyir/ mchog gi gzhi gnas ma gtogs 'gog pa'am dman pa'i zhi gnas la ma song ba gal che bar snang ngo*/ ༈ de phyir tshogs drug la sogs kyi// 'char sgo gang yang mi dgag la// der 'dzin rjes 'brang ma song bar// rang babs lhug par mnyam bzhag pa'i// mchog gi zhi gnas 'di 'bad na// g.yo dang thob dang goms dang brtan// mthar phyin pa yi nyams rnams 'byung*// bde gsal mi rtog la sogs dang*// mngon shes gsal snang rdzu 'phrul sogs// ltar snang zag bcas yon tan rigs// ci tsam byung yang rlom sems dang*// zhen 'dzin nga rgyal ma bzhugs pa// 'di ni lhag par gal che gda'// nyams

515)snang lam rtags 'di 'dra yis// sgom chen bslus pa mang bar mthong*/ ༈ bde gshegs phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ 'dzin med 'od gsal ma shar bar// bde gsal nyam gyi zhen pa can// blo gzhag sgom gyi dgos pa med// gzugs med lha ru mi skye'am/ ces dang*/ nus mthu che ba'i gang zag de// grong chog gi mu sna gtad pa yin// rmi lam rno ba'i sgom chen de// 'dre rgyal 'gong gi 'gugs khrid byed pa yin/ ces gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang rje mi las/ gnyis med rtog pa ma shar na// thun mong yon tan yad yud kun// rgyal 'gong phyi pa rnams la'ang yod// de yi grub thob ga la btub/ ces sogs gsungs phyir/ nga bdag 'gong po 'di las skyon che ba gzhan gang yang med do// ༈ des na zhi gnas skyon med zhig /goms na sgom gyi rmang gzhi brtan// dngos gzhi lhag mthong ye shes kyang*// byin rlabs ngo sprod thob ma 516)thob// khyad kyi dbye ba ma gtogs pa// 'jig rten tha mal rnam rtog kyang*// lhag mthong rnam rtog der shar mod// zhi gnas mnyam bzhag skyong mkhan kyang*// lhag mthong nyid las gzhan ma yin// gnas dang mi gnas yengs ma yengs// lta mkhan rig mkhan tshor mkhan de// lhag mthong rig pa'i ye shes yin/ ༈ 'di las lhag pa'i lhag mthong zhes// logs su grub pa yod ma yin// de phyir mchog gi zhi gnas dang*// lhag mthong gnyis po dang po nas// lhan cig lhun gyis grub nas yod/ ༈ de'i phyir tshor ba bkag pa'i 'gog pa'i zhi gnas kyi sgom go mi chod pa'i gnad kyang*/ lhag mthong bkag pa'i skyon yin cing*/ mthar thug 'bras bu mngon gyur gyi yon tan dang sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams dang byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos so bdun sogs dang*/ mkhyen gnyis kyi yon tan mtha' dag 517) lhag mthong gi 'bras bu kho na yin phyir/ de bkag pa'i zhi gnas gcig pu ji tsam brtan kyang mi grol ba'i rgyu dang gnad kyang 'di yin no//

༈ sems nyid gnas sam 'gyus gyur ram// gang ltar 'dug kyang ngo bo la// ngos bzung bral ba'i rjen ne ba// kha dog dbyibs mtshan ma grub kyang*// gsal rig ma 'gag hrig ge ba// rnam rtog bzang ngan ci shar yang*// dngos por ma grub phyam me ba// tshogs drug yul snang gang la yang*// a 'thas ma zhen bun ne ba// 'di yin med pa'i gti mug tu// ma bying gsal rig lam me ba// bde nyams gsal nyams stong nyams kyis// ma bslad tha mal shes pa 'di// rang ngo rig la lhag mthong zhes// phyag rdzogs dbu ma zhi gcod kun// mthun pa'i snying po 'di lags kyi// 'di ka gcig 518)pu ngo shes 'tshal/ ༈ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa rnams su/ chos rnam par 'byed pa so so ji lta bar rtogs pa'i lhag mthong zhes ming du brjod pa de 'di nyid yin kyang*/ go ba rkyang pa dang tshig rkyang par song nas rang gi nyams thog tu khel ba'i gang zag dkon la/ sngags kyi theg par/ thabs lam gtso bor ston pa'i skabs rnams su ni/ bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes sogs su ming btags pa dang*/ grol lam phyag rdzogs zhi byed sogs su ni/ 'di skabs kyi lhag mthong 'di la/ sems kyi de kho na nyid ji ltar ba shes pa'i lhag mthong zhes su btags mod/ mthar mngon du gyur nas phyag chen lugs kyi sgom med/ rdzogs chen pa'i rig pa tshad phebs lta bu'i skabs re ni chos nyid ji bzhin pa'i don mngon du gyur ba'i lhag mthong zhes brjod pa ste/ de ltar lhag mthong gi rnam grangs gsum po 'di thams cad da lta'i tha mal shes pa rang ngo rig pa gcig pu la 'du bar shes par bya'o/ de ltar zhi gnas kyi skyon yon dang lhag mthong gi rang bzhin rnams bstan cing*/ mchog gi zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung 'jug yin tshul skyong tshul sogs bshad pa 'di kas sgom dngos gzhi brtan pa yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang chos kyi 'gros dang bstun te/

slar yang nyams len dngos rgyun du ji ltar bskyangs thabs brda mtshon brjod par bya ste/ ༈ 519)gang zhig zhi gnas brtan pa thob pa'am// min kyang cung zhig nges pa rnyed gyur nas// rgyun du nyams su ji ltar len zhe na// khrid gzhung tha dad phyag bzhes sna tshogs pas// lta thog sgom dang sgom thog lta tshol zhes// sems tshol dang ni zhi gnas sbyong ba gnyis// go rim snga rting mdzad tshul tha dad pa// gang ltar byed kyang dgos don mthun pa'i phyir// mnyam rjes bskyangs pa'i thog tu nam kyang gcig ༈ dbu ma'i lta khrid dag tu mnyam bzhag ni// stong nyid kho na bsgom zhing rjes thob tu// byams dang snying rje sgyu ma lta bu nyid// bsgoms par gsungs shing de yi lugs nyid la// mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i bsam gtan dang*// rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin zer/ ༈ 'di la rje sgam pa pos/ phar phyin theg pa bas ni rten 'brel la sogs 520) lung dang rig sgo nas snang la rang bzhin med par gtan la phab nas bsgom pa yin te/ mos pas stong nyid du byed pa yin/ de ni dbu ma pa'i bsgom lugs yin cing*/ de rang yang bsgom bya sgom byed dang bcas pa'i gnyis 'dzin gyi blo ru 'dug des lta ba ma rtogs dngos 'dzin la gnod pa bskyal pas sgrib pa ni dpag tu med pa mdzad nus te/ 'tshang rgya mi nus/ ces gsungs pa dang*/ yang*/ gzhan dag mi rtog pa dum gcig la mnyam par bzhags nas/ rjes smi lam sgyu ma ltar bsgom pa yin te/ bla ma mi la'i lugs la/ dug lnga dang rnam rtog thams cad gnyis med kyi ye shes su khyer nas goms tsa na thun mtshams med par mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig tu khyer ba yin/ ces sogs rgyas par gsungs so/ ༈ phyag chen rnams las rnal 'byor dang po pas// thun gyi dngos gzhi mnyam bzhag nyid bya zhing*// thun mtshams spyod lam dran pas skyong ba ni// rjes thob yin la goms pa mngon gyur tshe// thams cad

521)mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig 'gyur ro gsungs/ ༈ rdzogs chen phal cher gang zag gcig char ba// dag la dgongs phyir gdod nas mnyam rjes kyi// dbye ba med par rig dang ma rig gi /so mtshams gcig pur bsdus nas gsungs par mdzad// gang ltar na yang 'gag don nyams len la// da lta'i rang sems rjen pa'i 'dug tshul 'di// ched du spro dang bsdu sogs ma byas par// gang snang cir 'dug de nyid ngo shes tsam// skyong mkhan de la dran pa ces su btags// zhi gnas dus su gnas cha gtsor ston kyang*// 'di dus gnas 'gyu thams cad sgom du 'khyer// nyon mongs dug lnga na tsha sdug bsngal sogs// rnam rtog ngan pa'i tshul du shar ba'am// dad mos snying rje nges 'byung dag snang sogs// rnam par dkar ba'i 522)bye brag cir 'char kun// thams cad rang sems 'gag med rol rtsal du// rtogs shing chags sdang spong len mi bya bar// ro mnyam gnyug ma'i ngang la lhod kyi glod// sgom mo snyam pa'i blo dang yid byed kyi// zhen 'dzin tsam yang mi dgos rang sar bskyur// sgom bzang 'ong du re dang mi yongs dogs// la sogs zhe 'dod cis kyang ma bslad par// blo bral bzo med lhug par gzhag pa 'di// nges don ma lus kun gyi mnyam bzhag yin/ ༈ 'gro 'dug za nyal smra brjod la sogs tshe// a 'thas zhen pas spyad na 'khrul 'dzin yin// rang ngo rig tsam ma yengs tsam gyi ngang*// spyod lam gang yang sgom dang 'bral med nyid// de phyir rjes thob zer yang mnyam bzhag rang*/ ༈ gnyug ma'i rang 'gros skyong tshul ma shes na/ 523)/lus gnad lta stangs byas kyang mnyam bzhag min// mdor na gang shar dran rig zin phyin chad// ci byed sgom yin dran pas ma zin na// gnas pa brtan yang btang snyoms 'gog par zad// de nas tha mal shes rig 'di ka skyong*/ ji skad du/ bsam pa dag pa'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal gyis gsol ba/ dge slong rnal 'byor spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams ji lta bu lags bka' bstsal pa/

'di lta ste/ dper na thab kyi me gsad na dkar khung gi du ba chad pa 'gyur ba ltar/ sems stong par shes shing rig na/ gzugs snang stong*/ sgra grag stong*/ dri tshor stong*/ ro myong stong*/ reg reg stong gi nyams byung ste/ nam mkha' ma sgribs na gsal/ chu ma snyogs na dwangs so/ sems ma bcos na bde'o/ zhes dang*/ sems ngo shes pa'i dge slong gang*// ji ltar spyad kyang sgom pa'i ngang*// gnyug ma'i don la gnas pa yin/ ces gsungs phyir/ bskyangs gnas 224) shes na mnyam bzhag 'khor yug la dka' las cher mi 'byung ngo*/ gzhan yang 'gyu ba dang tshogs drug sogs bka' mi dgos pa'i tshul ni/ rdzogs chen gyi gzhung dag las/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes gsal ba la// yid kyi 'dzin rtog ma zhugs na// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa de ka rang*/ ces dang*/ rmi lam dag tu bde dang sdug bsngal yang*// sad pa'i tshe na rang bzhin yongs kyis mnyam// de bzhin rnam par rtog dang mi rtog kyang*// rig pa'i dus na rang bzhin ngo bor mnyam/ ces dang*/ rdzogs pa chen po a ro'i snyan rgyud las/ de las sems ni 'phro gyur na// dper na nam mkha'i sprin bzhin du// byung yang gzhi la gnod med ltar// de bzhin byang chub sems la yang*// rtog pas mi sgrib bcos mi dgos/ ces sogs dang*/ ru lu gser 'phreng las/ de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// sems nyid ma bcos so mar gzhag /dbang po mi dgag rang sar zhog /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs// gang mthong gang snang de nyid kyi// ngang la lhan ne mnyam par bzhag 525)/ gang yang mi dgag mi 'dzin cing*// mnyam nyid rang sa'i ngang du zhog ces sogs rgya cher gsungs shing*/ rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud sde 'bum phrag drug cu mtha' dag gnad don 'di ltar kho na mgrin gcig tu gsungs phyir lung 'dren gyis ga la lang zhing*/ de bzhin du/ phyag chen rnams su yang dgongs don 'di kho na 'ba' zhig lags mod de/

dpal sha wa ris/ rtsa ba chod cing sems nyid nam mkha' 'dra// bsgom du med pas yid la mi bya ste// ji ltar nam mkhas nam mkha' dmigs su med// de bzhin stong pas stong pa bsgom du med/ ces dang*/ 'di ltar dus gsum rnam pa thams cad du// yid la byar med mtha' bral gnyug ma'i ngang*// de nyid skyong la sgom zhes tha snyad btags// rlung gi mi bzung yid ni ma bcings par// ma bcos shes pa bu chung lta bur zhog /dran rtog byung na de nyid rang la ltos// chu dang rlabs gnyis tha dad mi rtog cing*// yid la byang med phyag rgya chen po la// bsgom rgyu rdul tsam 526) med pas mi bsgom ste// bsgom med don dang ma bral sgom pa'i mchog ces gsungs pa dang*/ dpal nā ro pas/ blta na rang gi sems la ltos// sems nyid cir yang ma grub pas// brjod du med cing yul las 'das// spros bral nam mkha' ngo bo nyid/ ces sogs dang*/ rje mar pas/ spyir snang ba ji ltar snang lags kyang*// ma rtogs dus na 'khrul snang ste// phyi yul gyi zhen pas 'ching bar byed// rtogs pa rnams la sgyu mar snang*// yul snang sems kyi grogs su 'char// mthar thug don la snang ma myong*// skye med chos skur rnam par dag /nang 'gyu ba sems kyi rnam shes 'di// ma rtogs dus na ma rig pa// las nyon mongs rnams kyi gzhi rtsa yin// rtogs na rang rig ye shes te// dkar po'i yon tan rdzogs par 'gyur// mthar thug don la ye shes med// chos rnams zad sar skyol lo gsungs/ ces dang*/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pas/ rang gi sems la cer gyi ltos// bltas pas mi mthong dngos po med// med pa'i 527) ngang la lhod de zhog /yal le phyad de 'dzin med zhog /yang cig rnam rtog skyes pa na// ngo yi cer gyi bzung mdzod la// kho rang thog tu lhod kyi zhog /rang sar grol bar the tshom med/ ces sogs gsungs pa dang*/ grub thob o rgyan pas/

tha mal pa'i rig pa'i 'char sgo la// yengs med chu bo'i rnal 'byor gyis// ma bcings shes pa yan par zhog /bzo med ngang du phyal la la/ zhes gsungs pa sogs/ mdor na phyag rdzogs kyi gzhung man ngag rnams dang*/ bla ma rgyud pa'i gsung sgros mtha' dag tu/ gnas 'gyu thams cad khyad med du sgom bskyang tshul 'ba' zhig dang*/ de bzhin du snang ba rnam rtog sogs thams cad ma spangs grogs su 'khyer thabs kho nar gsungs gda' na'ang*/ ding sang gsar rnying gis sgom chen phal mo ches ni/ ma yengs pa zer ba'i tshig 'di la go ba len lugs kyi stabs cig gis/ gnas pa skyong ba de sgom yin la gzhan thams cad sgom min no snyam pa byas nas/ zhi gnas gcig 528) pu la blo gtad mkhan sha stag mthong bas/ de ltar na da ni 'dul ba'i bstan pa dang*/ gsang sngags spyi'i phyag bzhes dang nyams len phal cher 'chal zhing nub par ma zad/ sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa yang nub la nye ba ma yin nam zhes rang nyid sems so/ ༈ gnas lugs gdod nas dag pa'i rang rig 'di// dbul po'i gter ltar rang la rang ma mthong*// gang 'di bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs gyur tshe// sku gsum dbyer med rang ngo rang gis shes// de tshe lta sgom spyod 'bras sa lam sogs// ming snyan mang por phye ba ma lus kyi// snying po'i rtsa ba gcig pu chod pa'i mthus// thob dang ma thob re dogs kho thag chod/ ༈ nyams rtogs drod rtags yon tan 'dod pa na// zhen chos ngar 'dzin khong du zhugs pa'i phyir// de la nam kyang sgom gyi skal bas dben// 'khor 'das yon tan gzhi la 528)lhun rdzogs par// ma shes lam rtags 'bras bu re byed na// de ni theg dman las kyang rab tu dman// gol sgrib bar chad mtha' dag de la 'byung*/ ༈ gang gis 'khor 'das sems su shes gyur pa// de la gol sa shor sa 'khrul sa sogs// gang yang 'byung ba'i gzhi rtsa ma mchis pas// 'bras bu'i yon tan rtsol med lhun grub bo//

༈ ji skad du/ til+lo pas/ lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum// ngo bo mnyam pa nyid rtogs na// dge sdig gnyis su med pa las// gal te rtog pa gzhan byung na// gdengs med phyir na rmongs par zad/ ces dang*/ sgam po pas/ lta ba 'gyur ba med pa la// gzhi rtsa chod pa'i rtogs pa 'tshal// sgom pa thun mtshams med pa la// dus gsum rgyun par gnas kyang 'tshal// tshul 'chos med pa'i spyod pa la// rang 'khris med pa'i gzhan 530) phan 'tshal// re dogs med pa'i 'bras bu la// goms pa mngon du gyur kyang 'tshal/ ces sogs gsungs shing*/ snyems thag sems la mi gcod par rtags dang mtshan ma'am rtogs dang yon tan sogs myur du 'ong bar re ba'i skyon ni/ grub chen gling ras kyi zhal nas/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa lta 'dod na// rtags dang mtshan ma 'dod na ring ba yin// rtags dang mtshan ma'i 'dod pa zad tsa na// sangs rgyas kyi dgongs par slebs pa yin/ ces dang*/ ji srid blo zhen yod bar// 'khor ba'i chu bo sgrol mi 'gyur// 'dzin pa thongs na grol ba'i gnad// zhe 'dod med na sangs rgyas yin/ ces gsungs so/ ༈ skabs 'dir nyid kyi dri ba'i dngos don ltar// rtogs pa gsha' ma shar dang ma shar gyis// dbye ba'i sa mtshams 'gag bsdus bstan pa ni// phyag chen rnal 'byor bzhi dang rdzogs chen gyi// snang nyams bzhi sogs bdag gis 531)yang yang du// sngar nas bris phyir skabs 'dir ma brjod kyang*// skabs don snying por nyams dang rtogs pa gnyis// dbye shan phyed phyir 'di ltar smras pa ni/ ༈ dbu ma la sogs theg pa thun mong ba'i// stong nyid snying rje'i ting 'dzin goms stobs kyis// byang chos so bdun la sogs rim pa rnams// tshig tshogs mang bas 'dir ni 'chad ma nus// gzhung chen rnams la gzigs mdzod gang ltar kyang*// thun mong theg pa'i sa lam rim bgrod kyi// yon tan rnam grangs mtha' dag myur lam 'dir// rdzogs phyir 'di don grub na de dag gi

/tshig la ltos mi dgos phyir spros pa skyungs/ ༈ 'di nyid lugs kyi rnal 'byor bzhi la sogs// nam gyi tshe na'ang sgom gyi ngo bo dang*// rang sems dbyer med nges pa rnyed pa la// rtogs pa shar ba zhes bya de kas chog ༈ 532)de ltar ma gyur bsgom bya'i nyams len dang*// bsgom mkhan sems gnyis tha dad lta bu'am// dran pa skyong mkhan skyong rgyu tha dad du// 'dzin na rtogs pa'i dngos gzhi ma shar ba'o/ ༈ des na bde dang gsal dang mi rtog sogs// gang 'char thams cad nyams dang myong ba ste// sgom gyi phyi shun 'ba' shig yin pas na// de dag ci la'ang zhen pa bya ba min/ ༈ rtse gcig chen po nyams kyi 'khor yug dang*// spros bral gang yang stong par 'char ba sogs// thams cad nyams myong tsam yin rlom sems spang*// bsgom rgyu sgom mkhan sems nyid kho rang yin// yengs dang dran pa gnyis ka kho rang yin// bzang rtog ngan rtog thams cad sems kho rang*// de nyid rang ngo shes pa'ang kho rang ste// kun kyang rang sems gcig pur thag 533)chod na// 'khor 'das dbyer med lta ba rtogs par sla// lta ba'i gzhi rtsa rang thog chod pa na// bsgom rgyu gzhan med rig pa gcig pu 'di// dus gsum rtag tu rang dang 'bral med phyir// rtogs pa 'char ba dka' tshegs med mod kyang*/ ༈ sems kyi gdar sha ma chod sgom chen gang*// sdug rus bskal brgyar 'bad kyang nyams la zhen// zhen pas 'khor ba'i rgyu nyid ma gtogs pa// phyag rdzogs 'bras bu mngon gyur ga la 'byung*// dbye bsdu sa mtshams thams cad 'di ru 'dus/ ༈ nyams kyi shun pa bral na rtogs pa dngos// rtogs pa zer yang rig pa lhad med nyid// rig pa lhad med de ni gnas lugs don// dgos don nyams len 'di ka gcig pu'o// 'di nyid dbang rim rab 'bring 534)tha khyad kyis// myur du rtogs dang rim gyis rtogs pa sogs// gang yang nyams len mtha' ru bskyangs byas na// blo zad chos zad gdod ma'i gzhi ru grol// rims nad byang ba'i skyes bu ji bzhin du// phyin chad 'khor bar 'khrul dogs mi 'byung zhing*// sku dang ye shes nyams len mthar phyin mthus// rtsol med thugs rjes gzhan don lhun grub 'gyur/

༈ hril gyi dril na tha mal shes pa 'di// rang sor gzhag pa gcig pu ma gtogs pa// lta sgom bzang 'dod bcos ma'i sgom byed dang*// nyams rtogs rnal 'byor sa lam bgrod 'dod dang*// shor sa gol sa 'ong dogs la sogs pa// gnyer khag thams cad rgyab tu bskyur la thong*/ rje rgod tshang pa'i gsungs las/ 'gag thog tu dril na kho bo ni da lta'i tha mal gyi shes pa grwa ma nyams pa 'di ka sangs rgyas kyi sar 535) 'khyer 'gro ba yin/ ces gsungs pa lta bu ma gtogs/ gzhan gang yang gi zhe 'dod mi bya ste/ skyes mchog chos rje'i zhal nas/ la la'i gzhed kyi mnyam bzhag brtan pa la// rjes kyi thun mtshams med par 'od gsal nyid// 'khor ra yug tu gyur pa sangs rgyas kyi// dgongs pa mngon du gyur pa yin par 'dod// rang gis go tshul 'di ltar lags par 'khums// mnyam rjes gnyis ka lcags zad rdar zad du// bag chags bcas pa gtan rlag nyid gyur pa'i// tha mal shes pa rjen pa chos skur go zhes dang*/ yon tan 'dod tshad zhe 'dod gcong gis zin// 'bras bu bsgrub tshad re ba'i sad kyis 'khyer// rtags mtshan 'dod tshad bdud gyi sgo rar tshud/ ces sogs gsungs pa nyid do/ ༈ bogs 'don ro snyoms brtul zhugs sogs// spyod pa'i rim pa mang gsungs kyang*// rang rgyud 'di ka thul gyur na// ro snyom gzhan dag dgos mi gda'// ding sang chos pa thams cad 536)kun// kho bo sgom chen rnal 'byor ram// dge sbyong yin zhes khas blangs nas// dad rdzas dkor zas la rngams shing*// cha lugs rnam dpyod ldan byed kyang*// rnyed bkur cung zhig ngan pa'am// tshig ngan zur tsam thos pa na// sgom dang dge sbyong mi dran par// dug sbrul bzhin du tshig byed na// dge sbyor bogs su ji ltar 'don// de 'dras ro snyoms ci tsug byed// des na gnyan khrod rgyu ba dang*// rkyen la snyems pa'i brtul zhugs sogs// gang yang bya dgos mi gda' yi// chos brgyad 'di la dge sbyor gyi// gnad kyis slob pa kho na zhig

/byung na chog ste dkon par mchi/ ༈ sngon 'bri gung gi sgom chen pa zhig gis/ kho bo sgyu lus 'byongs so zer ba la/ skyob pa rin po ches/ khyod la sgom skyon 'dug zer bas shin tu ma legs/ ces gsungs pas/ kho rab tu khros 537) tshe/ khyed sgyu lus 'byongs yod zer bas bltas pa yin gsungs pas/ skyengs pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ gzhan yang*/ rgyal sras rin po che thogs med pas/ lto 'grangs nyi ma dros tshe chos pa'i gzugs// rkyen ngan thog tu babs na tha mal pa// rang sems chos dang 'dres bar mi gda' yis// blo 'di las su rung bar byin gyis rlobs/ ces gsungs pa/ 'di la spyi bos lan brgyar 'dud re bar snang ngo*/ gzhan yang rang rgyud chos kyi ma 'thul na rnal 'byor pa'am dge sbyong gi cha lugs tsam byas pa 'di gcig pus ni gang yang mi phan te/ ched du brjod pa'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' bstsal pa/ dge sbyong mgo reg la byang chub ga la yod/ snal ma ser po la byang chub ga la yod/ chus bkrus pa la byang chub ga la yod/ dgong lto bcag pa la byang chub ga la yod/ ces gsungs pas/ 'khor rnams the tshom dang yid gnyis su gyur te/ 'o na byang chub 538) cis thob pa yin snyam pa la/ bka' stsal pa/ shes rab kyi spu gris rnam rtog gi skra 'breg par bya'o/ stong pa nyid kyi gos kyis nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba las skyobs par bya'o/ ye shes kyi chus ma rig pa bkru bar bya'o/ bsam gtan gyi zas kyis 'dod pa'i bkres pa bsal bar bya'o/ zhes gsungs shing*/ chos dang sems ma 'dres na thos pa che ba'am mang po shes pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas mi thob pa'i tshul yang*/ chos 'byung ba med pa'i mdo las/ spyod lam dag dang 'khrul pa chag gyur cing*// tshig dang smra la dga' na mi btsun te// chos kyi rang bzhin yongs su ma shes na// tshig gi dag pas byang chub 'tshang mi rgya/ zhes dang*/

sangs rgyas phal po cher/ yang dag sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di// thos pa tsam gyis mi 'grub bo// la la stobs med chu klung gi /nan gyis 'khyer bar gyur pa dag /skom nas shi bar gyur ba bzhin// ma bsgom chos kyang de dang 'dra/ cazhas dang*/ chu bo dang ni rgya mtsho la// gru dang gzings bca'i gnyan pa yang*/ 539)/ gzhan dag de yis sgrol byed kyang*// bdag nyid chu la shi ba bzhin// ma bsgom chos kyang de dang 'dra/ zhes sogs mang du gsungs mod kyi/ deng sang gi rang gzhan chos par khas ches pa phal cher ni/ rgyal ba yang dgon pas gsungs pa lta bu kho nar zad de/ de'i gsungs sgros las/ 'o skol rnams chos kyi phyogs su ni nub gcig gi gnyid stabs sam/ nyin gcig gi las stabs sam/ dar gcig gi bya byed kyi stabs kyang mi gcog par bsgrub bya tshe 'di kho na'i dbang du gtang*/ dam pa'i chos 'di byed snying 'dod na ni byed/ mi 'dod na ni 'jog stabs su bde na ni byed/ mi bde na ni 'jog cing*/ nyan long med par ni sgom 'dod/ bsgom long med par ni grub rtags 'dod/ chos bya long med par de ma thag tu grub thob bam/ rtogs ldan nam/ mngon shes sam/ rdzu 'phrul lam/ ci 'dra ma 'dra zhig 'ong 'dod/ de ma byung tsa na nga 'dra bas chos sam de mi yong bar 'dug snyam nas sems zhum ste sgrub pa byed 'phro bshol/ ma bsgom ma bsgrub pa'i sangs rgyas cig 'o skol la dgos 540) par 'dug ste mi mchi/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ brtson 'grus srang la bcur nas nyin med mtshan med du bsgom dgos pa yin/ 'o skol ri khrod du bsdad lo/ mtshams byed lo/ sgom chen bzang po yin lor byas nas/ nyin mo lhan 'dug byed/ nub mo gnyid du log ri khrod nas mtshams thon rtsa na/ dge sbyor la thogs sam blo skyed ci yang med par blo rgyud bsra 'thas ser byas pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi chos pa de 'dras mi yong*/

ces gsungs pa dang*/ yang*/ bla ma sangs rgyas dang mjal/ gdams ngag bdud rtsir song*/ sgom pa gangs dkar kyi rgyal po ti ser song kyang*/ rang rgyud ma thul ba'i sangs rgyas mi 'ong*/ nyams rtogs de bsgom mkhan rang dgos pa yin/ bsgom nas ster mi su la'ang mi 'ong*/ zhes sogs mang du gsungs snang ba shin tu bden par gda' mod la/ lar yang chos kyi snying po sgrub pa gtso bor ma nus na gzhan gang gis don 'grub par dka' ste/ mdo sde bskal bzang las/ yang dag sgrub la gnas pa ma gtogs pa/ 541) /gzhan gyis byang chub mchog ni thob mi 'gyur/ ces gsungs shing*/ gdams pa'i zab gnad la nyams len snying por dril nus na chos thams cad kyi snying po lon pa yin te/ ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdor/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// ngas ni mdo sde gang bshad pa// tshig 'bru tha dad don gcig ste// thams cad bsgom par nus ma yin// tshig gcig rnam par bsgom pa yis// de dag thams cad bsgom par 'gyur/ ces gsungs pa bzhin 'gyur la/ de ltar gyur tshe/ da lta 'phral dul ma rtags sam yon tan yin zer ba'i mngon mtshan can zhig dgos pa ma yin te/ don gyi dgos pa thams cad grub cing nam gzhag gtan 'dun 'grub pa yin te/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ rig pa stong pa la phyi rol gyis dngos po gang gis kyang mi gnod/ rkyen gang gis kyang bar du mi gcod/ 'khor ba'i gdos thag chad pas rigs drug tu skye ba'i rgyu mi rnyed/ rnam par rtog pa'i rol brgya rig pa skad cig ma'i gshol 'og tu tshud pas chos 542) nyid stong gsal dwangs pa la nyon mongs pa'i dug ro ldang mi srid/ rnam smin rtsa ba zad pas sdig pa 'phyags mas btabs/ lus ngan blangs pa med pas ngan song gi sgo chod/ snang srid sems su shes pas dmyal ba gtan nas ma grub/ man ngag 'di lta bu dang phrad nas yengs med rtse gcig tu nyams su len pa'i gang zag la 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa mi dgos te/

tshe gcig 'di la nam gzhag gtan gyi so nam zin pa yin no/ zhes gsungs pas/ de lta bur 'gyur ba la 'bad par bya dgos so// ༈ de phyir dal 'byor don yod mdzad bzhed rnams// bshes gnyen mchog bsten gdams pa'i sgro 'dogs gcad// 'chi ba snying bsam 'jig rten zhen pa skyungs// chos brgyad mgo bsnyoms sems dang chos su bsre/ ༈ lta sgom snying por rig pa rjen pa skyongs// spyod lam snying por sgrub rgyud rnam thar skyong*// dam sdom snying por rgyu 'bras khyad mi gsad// phrin las snying por nga 543)bdag 'gong po thul/ ༈ stong lta kha 'byams ma shor lag len thebs// spros bcas zhen phyir mi 'brang sgyu mar rtogs// gnyis 'dzin grogs su ma chud gu yangs grol/ chos kyi kyi 'gags don shes pa gal cher gda'/ ༈ kyi hud/ snyigs dus ngan dgu mtha' dag tshang ba yis// thub bstan shing rta 'dam du rab byings bas// da ni bstan don yin zhes cir 'bad kyang*// bstan pa'i don dngos 'gyur ba'i re thag chad// rang phyogs grub mtha' bzung ba'i phyogs zhen dang*// dgon 'dzin 'khor slob skyong ba'i 'du 'dzi dang*// zang zing dkor zas bsgrub pa'i sgo bshom sogs// rang byas 'gyod cing gzhan la'ang smon pa zad/ ༈ don bral tshig la 'khor ba'i thos bsam dang*// rnyed grags bsgrub zong shes shes rnams grangs dang*// rang gzhan gnyis phung bla gzugs 'dzin la sogs// slan 544)chad nam yang byed par ma gyur smon/ ༈ rgyal bas bsngags pa'i nags khrod lung stongs su// cis kyang dgos med shes pa'i nges 'byung gis// rang sems gdod ma'i sangs rgyas mjal ba la// bdag gzhan skye dgu ma lus brtson par shog ༈ chos kun lta sgom snying po gcig gzhol ba'i// gnad don rgyal ba'i gsung gi lung rgyab bcas// lhag bsam dag pas 'dir bkod dge tshogs mthus/ srid mtsho myur skems 'gro kun byang chub shog

de ltar lam zab mo phyag rdzogs dbu sogs kyi lta sgom nyams len gnad don gyi zin bris dgos zhes/ dge slong smon lam pas bskul bar mdzad pa'i ngor 'di ltar bkod kyang*/ rang nyid la nges pa rnyed pa'i nyams rtogs ma mchis tshe/ dgongs don ji bzhin pa thog tu khel ba dka' zhing*/ brjod bya rnams kyang chang gi gzi ba'i gtam tshig bzhin 'chol le ba zhig las ma byung na'ang 'on kyang rnam dkar gzhan phan kho 545) nar bsam pa ma gtogs gzhan gyi dri ma med cing*/ gang zag mchog dman kun gyi go sla ba'i phyir*/ snyan dngags sogs tshig gis mdzes cha ma byas par phal skad ltar don rjen chung kho nar byas pa 'di ni/ rgod phug bya skyibs kyi dben gnas ga la ba der/ sna tshogs rang grol gyis dbo zla'i dkar phyogs kyis tshes khrir mngon par 'dzegs pa'i dus dge bar bris pa'i dge 'bras kyis/ 'gro ba kun kyang lam zab 'di ltar bu la brtson pa mthar phyin par gyur cig/ dge'o//
